SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,customeraccountid)
,convert(varchar,LimitTypeId)
,convert(date,convert(varchar,Timestamp))
,convert(numeric,LimitAmount)
,convert(varchar,IsoCurrencyCode)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
))  HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,LimitTypeId,Timestamp
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,customeraccountid)
,convert(varchar,LimitTypeId)
,convert(date,convert(varchar,Timestamp))
,convert(numeric,LimitAmount)
,convert(varchar,IsoCurrencyCode)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, LimitTypeId, Timestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'	
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.LimitTypeId,TGT.LimitTypeId) AS LimitTypeId	
	,ISNULL(SRC.Timestamp,TGT.Timestamp) AS Timestamp	
	,CASE
	    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit_TGT	TGT
ON	convert(varchar,SRC.CustomerAccountId) = convert(varchar,TGT.CustomerAccountId)
AND SRC.LimitTypeId = TGT.LimitTypeId
AND SRC.Timestamp = TGT.TimeStamp
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)



SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
     [CustomerAccountId] = SRC.CustomerAccountId
	,[LimitTypeId] = SRC.LimitTypeId
	,[Timestamp] = SRC.Timestamp
	,[LimitAmount] = SRC.LimitAmount
	,[LimitEndTimestamp] = NULL
	,[IsoCurrencyCode] = SRC.IsoCurrencyCode
	,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,[SourceSystemCode] = 'LNS'
	,[TaskRunId] = 0
	,[WorkFlowId] = 0
	,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.LimitTypeId = TGT.LimitTypeId AND DELTA.Timestamp = TGT.Timestamp AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND SRC.LimitTypeId = TGT.LimitTypeId AND SRC.Timestamp = TGT.Timestamp;



-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit
(
    CustomerAccountId
	,LimitTypeId
	,Timestamp
	,LimitAmount
	,LimitEndTimestamp
	,IsoCurrencyCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
     SRC.CustomerAccountId
	,SRC.LimitTypeId
	,SRC.Timestamp
	,SRC.LimitAmount
	,NULL AS LimitEndTimestamp
	,SRC.IsoCurrencyCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.LimitTypeId = SRC.LimitTypeId AND DELTA.Timestamp = SRC.Timestamp 
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit_DELTA;

END
